subject: Fix typo in ft.aggregate commit
reason: The change only fixes a typo in an error string inside the filter_str.empty() branch of the file-local ParseKNN (ft_search_parser.cc:185). That branch is unreachable: ParseKNN's sole caller, PreParseQueryString at ft_search_parser.cc:393, is guarded by !vector_filter.empty() on the very string it passes as filter_str. The client-reachable empty-vector-clause error (e.g. FT.SEARCH idx '*' on a vector index) is produced at ft_search_parser.cc:386, whose message was already correct in both the parent and the change. No command reply or other observable behaviour differs between the two builds, so
